question: With which bank did Indian Army sign an MoU for serving retired personnel in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Baroda**__.

__
 
• **Indian Army signed an MoU with Bank of Baroda for serving retired personnel in December 2020**__.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Army and Bank of Baroda** have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding for '**Baroda Military Salary Package**'

 
 
• Under the MOU bank would offer customized services along with facilities to the account holders.
 
• **Benefits**: Free Personal Accidental Insurance Cover, Permanent Total Disability Cover, Partial Disability Cover, Air Accident Insurance cover, Higher Education, Girl Child Marriage cover on death in case of serving personnel, Unlimited free ATM transactions at all bank ATMs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
